title: Waste of money
text: Waste of money. [[VIDEOID:ac94bcbdb29a7fd5605bc5a7f5997a5f]] The holes don’t match up or Aline. I am so upset, because I was so excited about putting this in my bathroom. They need to really look into who is sending this crap out, this is beyond disappointing.

product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Bathroom Storage Cabinet, Floor Cabinet Cupboard, with Large Storage Capacity, Printed Marble-Like Pattern, Open Shelf, and Adjustable Closed Shelf, 23.6 x 11.8 x 31.5 Inches, White UBBC68WT
features: Note : To ensure proper assembly, please follow all steps provided in the User Manual (provided in pdf below)
JUST THE TICKET FOR BATHROOMS: Hand towel on the open shelf, lotions and cleaners in the cabinet—this bathroom cabinet turns where’s-my-toothbrush chaos into easy-to-get-ready status instantly

ONE OF A KIND: Printed marble-like patterns infuse a timeless aesthetic of natural elegance，and convenient triangular cutout handles are in a class by themselves—giving your bathroom a unique update together

QUALITY ISN’T LOST: Though stunning in looks, it doesn’t sacrifice quality. Crafted of P2-grade engineered wood and covered in premium paint, this storage cabinet will last and look great for years to come

BOASTS OPEN AND CLOSED STORAGE: Whether to easily grab frequently used items or store out-of-sight items, this floor cabinet will satisfy all your demands; also, you may adjust the shelf in the cabinet to fit differently sized bottles

NOT SATISFIED YET? Our professional customer service is at your disposal for any questions you may have; so don’t wait any longer, give your bathroom a brilliant addition with this marble-look storage cabinet
description: The printed marble-like patterns lend a natural appeal, the triangular door handles bring some uniqueness, and the white colour adds a refreshing touch. This bathroom cabinet creates a beautifully relaxing atmosphere for you to enjoy and recharge.

This storage cabinet is not only designed to hold, well, bathroom items. You may also use it for cooking utensils, books, potted plants, framed pictures, etc. Wherever you place it, it will always come in full play.
If you like this storage cabinet, be sure to check other marble-pattern bathroom furnishings from VASAGLE!

- Color: White  - Material: P2-Grade MDF(Medium Density Fiberboard)  - Product Size: 23.6”L x 11.8”W x 31.5”H (60 x 30 x 80 cm)  - Product Weight: 29.1 lb (13.2 kg)  - Max. Total Static Load Capacity: 33 lb (15 kg)
